purpose: One credibility tag for every kind of spatial statement the digital campus makes. tools/campus-audit reads this file, expands it over every feature in assets/walk/campus.json and refuses any 'surveyed' tag that does not point at a raw survey file kept in the repository.

tags.surveyed: Measured on site (tape, total station, GNSS, laser scan, photogrammetry with ground control) and the raw measurement file is kept in this repository. Nothing currently qualifies.
tags.public-map: Read from public mapping or imagery (OSM, Esri World Imagery, official site plan) whose source, date and method are recorded; accuracy limited by that source.
tags.estimated: An interpretation: proportions read from photographs, generic dimensions (court sizes, storey heights), or legacy data whose origin cannot be checked any more. Plausible, not measured.
tags.invented: Created for the experience with no spatial evidence (interiors, door positions, tree positions in planted beds, character routes).
tags.documented: Non-spatial facts (names, dates, uses) taken from public documents; graded separately in lanren/roots/history.js for the history chapter.

aspects.identity: That the feature exists and what it is called / used for
aspects.position: Where its centre is on the campus
aspects.orientation: Its bearing relative to true north
aspects.height: Storeys, storey height and overall height
aspects.facade: Materials, windows, roofs and other visible detail

orientation.basis: Campus axis rotated about 41° anticlockwise from true north. The legacy note claims 41.4° from a three-point collinearity solve on the lost KML; the audit independently fits 6 landmarks on the Esri World Imagery layer in assets/cinematic/aligned (manifest.json) and the two legacy Amap anchors, and both agree within about 2°.

scale.basis: Plan pixels × 0.167 m. The imagery fit gives a model-to-ground scale near 1.03 (model about 3% small) with roughly 9 m RMS residual: good enough for orientation and neighbourhood layout, not for measurement.

georeference.basis: anchors.center / anchors.southGate are Amap GCJ-02 coordinates (docs/descent-review.md). Converted to WGS84 they sit about 500 m from their raw values; any use as WGS84 is wrong by that much.

identity.basis: Names and uses follow the school's public pages and the project's photographs (building note fields).

position.basis: Legacy KML conversion (no_project2.xml) whose raw file and conversion script are missing; independently corroborated against public imagery to about ±10 m where a landmark is visible (see control-points.json).

footprint.basis: Axis-aligned rectangles in the campus frame from the same legacy conversion; real outlines are often L/U/courtyard shapes the rectangle does not capture.

orientation.basis: Snapped to the campus axis (rot 0) unless stated; the imagery shows most blocks follow it.

height.basis: floors × floorH from a project 'height rule' (teaching 19 m, science 23.4 m, dormitory 25.2 m, art centre 8 m); storey counts read from photographs, storey heights generic.

facade.basis: Photo-informed interpretation (data/architecture.json, assets/walk/review.js); proportions not measured.

interior.basis: Interiors are not modelled or are original interpretations (assets/walk/interiors.js).
